statement:
CATE analysis (n=1000, CausalForestDML, RBF-surrogate BO): global CATE=+0.2210 [0.1708, 0.2711]; 100% of campaigns have positive CATE. Subgroups: high_snr_long_budget (n=286): ATE=+0.1893 [0.147, 0.231]
high_snr_short_budget (n=214): ATE=+0.1933 [0.154, 0.233]
low_snr_long_budget (n=294): ATE=+0.2603 [0.200, 0.321]
low_snr_short_budget (n=206): ATE=+0.2377 [0.180, 0.295].
caveats: CausalForestDML uses GBM nuisance models — may overfit with small n.
n_dims is constant within this simulation; its importance is not identifiable.
Subgroup CIs are averaged pointwise — not joint CIs.
Honest splitting reduces bias but increases variance with small n.
All data is synthetic (RBF-surrogate simulation) — validate thresholds on real experimental data before deployment.
